name: Amy Young
source: Although Daniel believes to never have shared a conversation with her, he sure remembers Amy Young. How could he not? She was possibly the most popular girl at high school, cheerleader captain with the best grades, the best boyfriend, apparently soon-to-be best husband now. Yet she shows up at Tony's bar looking to complete a bucket-list before her big day. Nothing Daniel used to think about her seems to match her personality, from her big, carefree smile to the truth behind it.
